name: Amai Kokona
source:
She joined a major AV company in hopes of being a porn actress. A cheerful girl who gives her all to sex. 

She's rooting for the timid [url=https://vndb.org/c122560]protagonist[/url].

Her family has a debt, and wanting to pay for her little brother's education, she strives to make her name known in the AV industry. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_227.html#story]Official Site[/url]]
